# Drawer — Library Analysis

### Quick Comparison

| | Vaul | Mantine | MUI | Ant Design | shadcn/ui |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Props** | Minimal, gesture-focused | Rich, size presets | Variant-driven | Slot-heavy (title/footer/extra) | Thin Vaul wrapper |
| **Compound** | Yes (Radix-style) | Both mono + compound | Monolithic | Monolithic | Yes (Vaul-based) |
| **Standout** | Snap points + bg scaling | Drawer.Stack | persistent/permanent variants | Nested push offset | Responsive Dialog/Drawer recipe |

### Props Detail

|------|------|---------|
| `open` | `boolean` | - |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | - |

| `direction` | `'top' \| 'bottom' \| 'left' \| 'right'` | `'bottom'` |

<Drawer.Root shouldScaleBackground>

#### shadcn/ui

Thin wrapper around Vaul. Adds `DrawerHeader`, `DrawerFooter` as layout divs. Inherits all Vaul props.

```tsx
<Drawer>
  <DrawerTrigger>Open</DrawerTrigger>
  <DrawerContent>
    <DrawerHeader>
      <DrawerTitle>Title</DrawerTitle>
      <DrawerDescription>Description</DrawerDescription>
    </DrawerHeader>
    <DrawerFooter>
      <Button>Submit</Button>
      <DrawerClose><Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button></DrawerClose>
    </DrawerFooter>
  </DrawerContent>
</Drawer>
```

### Recommendations for Move

1. **Components to build:**
   - `Drawer` — slide-in panel from any edge, overlay with backdrop
   - Sub-components: `Drawer.Header`, `Drawer.Body`, `Drawer.Footer`, `Drawer.CloseButton`

2. **Props consensus:**
   - `open` / `onOpenChange` — controlled state (all libs)
   - `position` / `placement` — all four edges (`'left' | 'right' | 'top' | 'bottom'`), consensus name: `position`
   - `size` — width (left/right) or height (top/bottom), Mantine uses presets
   - `closeOnEscape` — all support, default `true`
   - `closeOnClickOutside` — all support, default `true`
   - `title` — Mantine/Ant have it as prop; compound pattern uses `Drawer.Header`
   - `withCloseButton` — Mantine/Ant default `true`
   - `overlay` — backdrop/mask, all have it, default `true`

3. **Composition:** Compound pattern with monolithic shorthand, matching Move's existing Dialog pattern. `Drawer.Root` + `Drawer.Header` + `Drawer.Body` + `Drawer.Footer` + `Drawer.CloseButton`. Monolithic mode accepts `title` prop and auto-renders header.

4. **Animation:**
   - **Slide in/out** from the relevant edge — core animation, all libs do this
   - **Overlay fade** — backdrop fades in/out simultaneously
   - Map to Move's `useAnimations` with lifecycle enter/exit triggers
   - Use `animatePosition` (translateX/translateY based on position)
   - Spring: `sidebar` or `quick` — the drawer should feel snappy but not jarring

5. **Component class:** Overlay (alongside Dialog, Popover, Dropdown, Toast)

6. **Default candidates (not decisions):**
   - `position`: `'right'` (most common for settings/detail panels) — high confidence
   - `size`: `'md'` (≈ 320px) with presets `xs/sm/md/lg/xl/full` — medium confidence
   - `closeOnEscape`: `true` — high confidence
   - `closeOnClickOutside`: `true` — high confidence
   - `withCloseButton`: `true` — high confidence
   - `overlay`: `true` — high confidence
   - `trapFocus`: `true` — high confidence

7. **Responsive behavior:**

   **Industry consensus:** No library auto-switches — responsive behavior is always consumer-side via a JS `useMediaQuery` hook (not CSS, because different component trees render).

   **Dominant pattern:** Side drawer on desktop → bottom sheet on mobile (breakpoint ~768px).

   | Library | Approach |
   |---------|----------|
   | shadcn/ui | Documents a "Responsive Dialog" recipe: `useMediaQuery` → render `<Dialog>` on desktop, `<Drawer direction="bottom">` on mobile |
   | Vaul | `direction` is a static prop; consumer changes it per viewport |
   | Mantine | Recommends visibility utility classes or JS hook to swap position |
   | MUI | `temporary` variant on mobile, `permanent` on desktop; `SwipeableDrawer` for mobile gestures |

   **Mobile-specific features across ecosystem:**
   - Drag handle / drag-to-dismiss (Vaul, MUI SwipeableDrawer)
   - Snap points for peek / half / full states (Vaul only)
   - Keyboard-aware input repositioning (Vaul)

   **Recommendation for Move:**
   - Add a `responsive` prop (default `true`) that automatically switches `position` to `'bottom'` below a configurable breakpoint
   - When in bottom-sheet mode: render a drag handle, use `animatePosition` on Y axis, constrain max-height to ~85vh
   - Implementation: internal `useMediaQuery` hook (Move may already have one or can add to engine)
   - This is a differentiator — no other library does this automatically; they all push it to the consumer
   - Keep snap points and swipe gestures out of v1 — the auto-position-switch alone is high value

8. **Key decisions:**
   - **Auto-responsive or manual?** Recommending auto with opt-out (`responsive: false`). This would be unique in the ecosystem and fits Move's "batteries-included" philosophy. Needs user confirmation.
   - **Snap points / drag gesture?** Vaul's killer feature but adds complexity. Could be a future enhancement rather than v1. Move doesn't currently use gesture libraries.
   - **Persistent variant?** MUI's persistent/permanent modes push content aside — useful for app shells but architecturally different (not an overlay). Recommend skipping for v1; the Sidebar component or layout patterns can handle this.
   - **Nested drawers / stack?** Ant's `push` and Mantine's `Drawer.Stack` are nice but niche. Recommend deferring.
   - **Relationship to Dialog?** Both are overlay + focus-trap + close-on-escape. Could share a base (Radix Dialog primitives). Move already has Dialog — Drawer could reuse its overlay/portal/focus-trap infrastructure.
   - **Breakpoint value?** 768px is the ecosystem standard. Could also tie into Move's theme breakpoint tokens if they exist.
